twilio:index:ChannelsSender.description: A Twilio WhatsApp sender (Messaging v2 Channels Senders; not a messaging service sender pool member). The resource ID is the sender SID (XE...). Create registers the phone number and returns at once; the sender then goes through verification and Meta review, which can take days. Read `status`, `offlineReasons` and `pendingDisplayNameStatus` to follow it, and set configuration.verificationCode in a later update when Twilio asks for the one-time code (status PENDING_VERIFICATION). A changed profile.name is submitted to Meta for review; until Meta approves it Twilio keeps reporting the old name, and this resource keeps your new name in state so there is no drift while the review is pending. If the review fails (DECLINED, EXPIRED, PIN_MISMATCH, REGISTRATION_FAILED) the active name is reported and the next update re-submits the name. Optional settings that are removed leave the setting as it is on Twilio. RCS senders are not managed here because Twilio documents update and delete for WhatsApp only; read them with getChannelsSenders.

twilio:index:UsAppToPerson.description: An A2P 10DLC campaign (US App to Person) of a Messaging Service, registered under an approved BrandRegistration. The resource ID is <messagingServiceSid>/<sid>. The description, message flow, message samples, link and phone flags, age gate, direct lending flag and policy URLs update in place; anything else replaces the campaign. A campaign is reviewed by The Campaign Registry and billed by Twilio and the registry: its status changes after creation. Destroying the resource deletes the campaign.

accountSid.description: The SID of the account that owns the campaign.

ageGated.description: Whether the campaign requires an age gate for federally legal content. Updates in place; Twilio treats an unset value as false.

brandRegistrationSid.description: SID (BN...) of the approved BrandRegistration the campaign is registered under. Changing it replaces the campaign.

campaignId.description: The Campaign Registry (TCR) campaign ID (empty until assigned).

campaignStatus.description: The campaign status, for example IN_PROGRESS, VERIFIED or FAILED. It changes as The Campaign Registry reviews the campaign, so a refresh can show a new value.

dateUpdated.description: When the campaign was last updated (ISO 8601).

description.description: What the campaign does (Twilio asks for 40 to 4096 characters). Updates in place.

directLending.description: Whether the campaign allows direct lending. Updates in place; Twilio treats an unset value as false.

errors.description: Why the registration failed, each error as a JSON document (empty when there are none).

hasEmbeddedLinks.description: Whether the campaign's messages contain links. Updates in place.

hasEmbeddedPhone.description: Whether the campaign's messages contain phone numbers. Updates in place.

isExternallyRegistered.description: Whether the campaign was registered outside Twilio.

messageSamples.description: Sample messages of the campaign (Twilio asks for two to five of 20 to 1024 characters). Order is not significant. Updates in place.

twilio:index:getTrunk.description: Look up an Elastic SIP trunk by SID, including its termination domain and recording settings.

accountSid.description: SID of the account that owns the trunk.

authType.description: The authentication types of the trunk, IP_ACL and CREDENTIAL_LIST (comma-delimited when both).

cnamLookupEnabled.description: Whether Caller ID Name (CNAM) lookup is enabled for inbound calls (default false). Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.

dateUpdated.description: When the trunk was last updated (RFC 2822).

disasterRecoveryMethod.description: HTTP method used to request disasterRecoveryUrl, GET or POST (Twilio default POST).

disasterRecoveryUrl.description: URL Twilio requests (with disasterRecoveryMethod) when it cannot reach your origination URLs. Removing it clears the URL.

domainName.description: The termination SIP domain of the trunk, <name>.pstn.twilio.com: the address your SIP infrastructure sends calls to. Letters, digits and "-" only; it is unique across Twilio. Changing it updates the trunk in place. Removing it leaves the domain unchanged on Twilio.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable name of the trunk (up to 64 characters). Removing it leaves the name unchanged on Twilio.

recordingMode.description: Call recording mode: do-not-record (Twilio default), record-from-ringing, record-from-answer, record-from-ringing-dual or record-from-answer-dual. Twilio changes it on the trunk's Recording sub-resource; the provider sets it there. Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.

recordingTrim.description: Whether silence is trimmed from recordings: do-not-trim (Twilio default) or trim-silence. Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.

secure.description: Whether Secure Trunking is enabled: SRTP for media and TLS for signalling on every call through the trunk (default false). Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.

transferCallerId.description: Caller ID of the transfer target: from-transferee (Twilio default) or from-transferor. Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.

transferMode.description: Call transfer setting: disable-all (Twilio default), enable-all or sip-only. Removing the input leaves the setting unchanged on Twilio.
